evidence: Independent review inspected the immutable renderer, registry, dock-layout, CSS, and test diff; the Diagnostics CSS class has the same intended dock sizing/overflow treatment as Inspector. CPU/view/layout checks and TypeScript check passed as submitted. The captured panels are collapsed and the native run has no runtime, so the evidence proves placement/recovery rather than live metric values; the unchanged widgets remain in Diagnostics source and expanded live-value QA is reserved for combined validation.
